daily_report.title: HVAC / Liquid-Cooling CDU Industry Intelligence Briefing
daily_report.headline: Copper nears record highs, e-glass cloth October hikes land, memory rally accelerating into finished devices; Chillventa 2026 day two draws record 1,095 exhibitors.

hotspot_events.heat_reason: LME copper nearing record highs with inventories steadily drawn down; clear Q4 copper price-lock window
hotspot_events.title: Copper nears record highs again: LME 10-12 settlement at $14,791.96/ton
hotspot_events.summary: LME copper settled 10-12 at $14,791.96/ton (up ~$240/ton from 10-9), nearing record highs; LME inventories fell to 231,275 tons on continued destocking; Japan's electric-copper benchmark (ashi-ne) reached 2,440 yen/kg, approaching all-time highs.

hotspot_events.heat_reason: E-glass cloth October hikes land with a relatively large increase this year; scaled new capacity not until end of next year
hotspot_events.title: E-glass cloth/yarn October price hikes land: 7628 standard cloth +RMB 1.5/m
hotspot_events.summary: 7628 standard e-glass cloth +RMB 1.5/m (a relatively large increase this year), G75 e-glass yarn +RMB 3,000/ton, thin cloth (2116/1080) +RMB 2.5/m; leading listed companies confirmed to China Securities Journal that the hikes are real, with scaled new capacity not releasing until end of next year.
numbers: New capacity release: end of next year

hotspot_events.heat_reason: Memory price rally accelerating into finished devices; Q4 contract prices expected up another 10%~20%
hotspot_events.title: Memory rally accelerating into finished devices: Huaqiangbei spot memory up over 300% in a year
hotspot_events.summary: Huaqiangbei spot memory up over 300% in a year (DDR4 16GB from ~RMB 100+ to 600+; DDR5 16GB from ~RMB 200+ to 1,400+); TrendForce expects Q4 mobile DRAM/NAND contract prices +10%~20% QoQ; Richard Yu acknowledged per-device memory costs up over $200, with price increases to follow.
numbers: Huaqiangbei spot memory +300%+ in a year
Q4 mobile memory contract prices expected +10%~20%

hotspot_events.heat_reason: Samsung Electro-Mechanics long-term agreements lock capacity through end-2027, reinforcing high-capacitance MLCC shortage expectations
hotspot_events.title: MLCC price-hike chain escalates: Samsung Electro-Mechanics agreement details disclosed, capacity locked through end-2027
hotspot_events.summary: Samsung Electro-Mechanics' 4th MLCC long-term agreement details disclosed this year: 4 agreements totaling KRW 2.11 trillion lock capacity through end-2027, plus ~KRW 1.5 trillion in silicon capacitor orders; Taiwan passive-component stocks hit limit-up on 10-01 on the AI power-supply high-end MLCC spec-upgrade narrative.
numbers: MLCC long-term agreements: KRW 2.11 trillion total (4 deals)

industry_updates.title: Chillventa 2026 enters day two with a record 1,095 exhibitors
industry_updates.summary: Held 10-13~15 in Nuremberg, Germany — the largest edition on record; natural refrigerants (R290/CO2/ammonia) and data-center cooling are the core themes.

industry_updates.title: Carrier Q3 earnings due 10-29; board declares $0.24/share quarterly dividend
industry_updates.summary: Carrier to report Q3 2026 earnings on October 29 with a conference call; board declared a $0.24/share quarterly dividend payable November 18. Investor matter, no substantive supply-chain impact.

industry_updates.title: Daikin and Nipro launch joint rail freight in Japan
industry_updates.summary: Since 10-02, rail shuttle runs between Sakaide plant (commercial AC components) and Miyagi logistics center with 31-ft containers in both directions; expected to cut 141.9 tons of CO2/year (-81%). ESG/logistics category.

industry_updates.title: Enex showcases five natural-refrigerant system solutions at Chillventa
industry_updates.summary: CO2 / ammonia / propane / water / newly added R600a solutions covering industrial refrigeration, heat pumps and data-center cooling; also V-type adiabatic dry coolers and R290 four-pipe heat pumps.

industry_updates.title: Guenter showcases heat-exchange technology and LCI lifecycle assessment tool at Chillventa
industry_updates.summary: New-generation high-efficiency heat-exchange technology + aicore intelligent controls + LCI lifecycle indicator tool, emphasizing full lifecycle energy/operating-cost/carbon assessment early in equipment selection.

cross_industry.key_data: Copper +33% YoY, ~25%~30% of AC cost, +RMB 200~300 per unit; mainstream brands raised all-category prices 5%~30% from April
cross_industry.chain: High copper prices → rising finished-unit costs → mainstream AC brands raise all-category prices 5%~30% → replacement demand under pressure; subsidy tail-off compounds, narrowing Q4 off-season price-war room

cross_industry.key_data: Apple/Huawei/Xiaomi raising prices in turn (iPhone 18 Pro series +RMB 1,000 entry); HP launches 16GB→8GB cut-down models; Gartner sees end-2026 PC ASP +17%, phones +13%
cross_industry.chain: AI siphoning memory capacity → memory 30%~40% of phone BOM → finished-unit price hikes / spec cuts; HVAC drive/control-board memory sourcing under the same pressure — a reference case
